title: Scott D. Whiting
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Jeri O. Whiting, 1984, Salt Lake City, Utah; Five children:
Bachelor's, Japanese from BYU, 1986; J.D., University of the Pacific McGeorge School of Law, 1990
President of Waterhouse Inc. for 10 years
Elders Quorum President, High Councilor, Stake Young Men President, Stake President. Prior to current call was serving in the North America West Area as an Area Seventy.
First Quorum of the Seventy, 2012 - present
